result.summary: Found 1 major issue and 1 minor issue: a data formatting bug showing '€NaN delivery' and a truncated restaurant card in the carousel.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card displays '€NaN delivery', indicating a broken/undefined price value being rendered as a raw NaN (Not a Number) string.
issues.suggestion: Fix the underlying data/calculation issue so delivery fee is a valid number; add fallback rendering to hide the fee or display 'Free delivery' or '—' when the value is missing.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccola) is cut off at the right edge with the delivery price partially clipped.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has adequate padding/end spacing so partially visible cards are cleanly clipped or fully shown with a peek affordance.
